license_required.quote: Any person, firm, or corporation not being duly authorized who shall engage in the business of general contracting in this state, except as provided for in this chapter, and any person, firm, or corporation presenting or attempting to file as its own the license certificate of another ... shall be deemed guilty of a Class A misdemeanor

issuing_authority.value: State Licensing Board for General Contractors

name.quote: there shall be a State Licensing Board for General Contractors, consisting of five members

type.quote: there shall be a State Licensing Board for General Contractors, consisting of five members, who shall be citizens of this state and appointed by the Governor

required.quote: A subcontractor is not required to sit for any examination before being licensed.

experience_source.quote: the board shall investigate thoroughly the financial responsibility and past record of all applicants, which will include an effort towards ascertaining the qualifications of an applicant in reading plans and specifications, estimating costs, construction ethics, and other similar matters

exams.name: General Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Board may require examination to determine qualifications; applicants may be reexamined at any regular or called meeting. Subcontractors are not required to sit for examination.
exams.quote: If the application is satisfactory to the board, then the applicant may be required to take an examination to determine his or her qualifications.

interval_years.quote: The certificate of authority to engage in the business of general contracting in the State of Alabama shall expire 12 months following its issuance or renewal and shall become invalid on that date unless renewed.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: Application for renewal of a license, together with the payment of a fee of two hundred dollars ($200)

available.quote: A licensee may apply for and, on proof satisfactory to the board, may receive an increase in the amount of his or her bid limit, change his or her classification, or verify his or her license with a reciprocating state for fees not greater than seventy-five dollars ($75) as set by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may levy and collect an administrative fine of not less than five hundred dollars ($500) nor more than five thousand dollars ($5,000) for any violation of any provision of this chapter or the rules and regulations of the board.

bonding_required.quote: the applicant may furnish a bond acceptable to the board equal in the amount of the applicant's negative working capital or net worth plus the amount of such net worth and working capital to satisfy the requested bid limit

insurance_required.quote: The applicant shall apply for a license covering the type or types of contracts on which he or she wishes to perform, and shall provide proof of liability insurance.

definition_quote.value: a 'general contractor' is defined to be one who, for a fixed price, commission, fee, or wage, undertakes to construct or superintend or engage in the construction, alteration, maintenance, repair, rehabilitation, remediation, reclamation, or demolition of any building, highway, sewer, structure, site work, grading, paving, or project or any improvement in the State of Alabama where the cost of the undertaking is one hundred thousand dollars ($100,000) or more.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
